ask_placeholder: Ask about air quality, your plan, or hacks...
tt_pm25: Fine particulate matter ≤ 2.5 µm that penetrates deep into lungs and bloodstream.
tt_naqi: India National Air Quality Index (0–500) based on 24-h CPCB pollutant breakpoints.
tt_budget: WHO 24-h guideline (15 µg/m³) multiplied by personal daily breathing volume.
tt_debit: Total PM2.5 mass inhaled into the respiratory tract over 24 hours (micrograms).
tt_cigs: Berkeley Earth rule of thumb: ~22 µg/m³ PM2.5 over 24h roughly equals 1 cigarette.
tt_blh: Boundary Layer Height: Lower layer traps smog; higher solar layer dilutes it.
tt_p90: 90th percentile forecast scenario (worst 10% plume risk under stagnant conditions).
tt_inversion: Cold ground air trapped under warm lid, preventing pollution from rising.
tt_mixing: Daytime solar heating expands atmospheric mixing layer, naturally reducing PM2.5.
tt_cadr: Clean Air Delivery Rate (m³/h) indicating air purifier volume filtration speed.
tt_ach: Air Changes per Hour: rate at which total room air volume is fully replaced.
tt_flush: Optimal 1-hour window during peak daytime mixing to safely ventilate indoor air.
tt_mohalla: Scaling impact when neighbouring households adopt the same clean routine.
tt_weather_drivers: Real-time Open-Meteo meteorological factors driving pollutant dispersion.
tt_temp: Surface ambient temperature driving thermal inversion and air density layers.
tt_humidity: High humidity (>70%) accelerates aerosol particle growth and dense winter fog/smog.
tt_wind: Calm winds (<6 km/h) trap smoke locally; winds >12 km/h promote horizontal advection.
tt_blh_driver: Planetary boundary ceiling; shallow <400m traps emissions; afternoon sun lifts it >800m.
